detail.longDescription: Mastodon Bat-Signal time: I need options for a # selfhosting # opensource (running on # Linux or # macos attendance tracker. All it needs to do is track self reported ins and outs for registered users. It doesn't need to be tied to any particular events. It also doesn't (yet) need any biometrics or constantly refreshing QR codes or RFID, though adding this stuff later would be great. Any leads? Paid options seem outside the financial viability for this project.
